subject: Discovery follow-up & VP/CTO intro - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up & VP/CTO intro - Acme Health

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're aligned and can get the right folks scheduled: 

- Current setup: Acme is running a hybrid deployment for clinical search and triage, primarily on Azure VMs.
- Pain: unpredictable inference costs at scale, and latency spikes on peak loads for longer clinical notes.
- Goals: reduce per-query cost by ~40%, get P95 latency under 300ms for the triage route, and ensure SOC2-ready audit logging.
- Success metrics: cost per 1k requests, P95 latency, and audit log retention/completeness.

Next steps we discussed: schedule an executive alignment call so your VP/CTO and our Head of Product can confirm timeline, procurement constraints, and rollout approach — plus a technical deep dive with an inference engineer. I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and a proposed timeline.

Proposed exec call windows (PDT):
- Tue Apr 20, 10:00-10:30 AM
- Wed Apr 21, 9:00-9:30 AM

If those don't work, please share a couple of times that work for Priya. Once we lock the exec call, we'll follow with a 60-minute technical deep dive with our runtime engineer and your platform team.

Attachments: AcmeHealth-MAP-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — make inference predictable and economical for production apps

Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:11:00 -0700

Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP, that's super helpful. Looping in Priya (CC'd) — she's our CTO and should join the exec alignment. Her availability is a bit tight the week of Apr 20, but she said she can do:

- Wed Apr 21, 9:00-9:30 AM PDT (preferred)
- Thu Apr 22, 11:00-11:30 AM PDT

PRIYA: Priya, Marissa is proposing an exec alignment + a subsequent technical deep dive with an inference engineer. Could you confirm which of the two windows works for you? For the technical deep dive, we'll want your platform lead (Anita) and one infra engineer there.

Cheers,

Thanks Sanjay, and hi Priya, great to e-meet you. Wed Apr 21, 9:00-9:30 AM PDT works on our side — I've tentatively blocked it on Calendly while we confirm.

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- 5m quick intros (VP/CTO + Head of Product)
- 10m high-level deployment & timeline alignment (milestones from MAP)
- 10m procurement/SLA & security checklist (SOC2, audit logs)
- 5m next steps: technical deep dive scheduling and owners

Rishi (CC'd), our solutions lead, will join the exec call and run the technical deep dive session with your infra team. Rishi, can you please bring a short slide with our recommended rollout options and one slide on quantization/latency tradeoffs?

Confirming: Wed Apr 21, 9:00-9:30 AM PDT (30 min). I'll send a calendar invite once Priya confirms. If you prefer, here's my Calendly to lock: https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/30min

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa
